    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0

    groups = {}
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]  # Up, Down, Left, Right

                else:

            moves_count = sum(moves)
            key = f"{moves_count}"
            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(state)
